This neuron's output is mostly negative, and its (weak) positive peaks sit on clause/phrase-final content words — head nouns or a sentence-ending period ("in law", "for vouchers", "logic board", "etc", "."), whereas it is strongly *suppressed* on the last token of a fixed multi-word compound or idiom ("medium-**high**", "sister in **law**", "ex-**wife**", "Southern **Brazilian**"), i.e. it discriminates a noun that ends a phrase from a word merely completing a set collocation.

L11·N8548unmasked layer
